prompt:
Game-ready PIXEL ART architectural tileset, 512x1024. EXACTLY TWO ADJACENT VERTICAL STRIPS, each 256 pixels wide and 1024 pixels tall, filling the entire canvas. This is an orthographic overhead RPG CUTAWAY WALL asset, not a picture of a street. Straight parallel vertical lines, NO vanishing point, NO diagonal isometric geometry, no horizon, no foreshortening with distance. Think detailed Stardew-like abandoned coastal town masonry at a consistent scale.
LEFT HALF x0..255: continuous west-side shop boundary, its street-facing edge runs exactly along x255. Weathered moss-green painted timber, warm brown brick repairs, narrow bronze rain pipe, dusty small shuttered windows seen from above, worn gold trim. Roofless shallow wall-top visible, light from upper left. RIGHT HALF x256..511: continuous east-side shop boundary, its street-facing edge runs exactly along x256. Weathered navy-blue painted timber, grey brick repairs, narrow iron rain pipe, dusty blue-glass small display windows seen from above, aged cream trim. Both walls run straight north-south down the picture at the same width. Four subtle groups of details spaced evenly down each strip; each group roughly 256 pixels high so this can be sampled as four square tiles. Fine discrete 2-3 pixel clusters, crisp edges, restrained colors, richly textured chips, tiny moss in cracks, no smooth airbrush. These are narrow low cutaway building walls, NOT tall facades, not a front elevation drawing. Top surfaces and side trim must read as overhead 2D map boundaries. NO doors or passage openings anywhere (game places doors separately), NO people, NO floor or street, NO background padding, NO letters, NO text, NO icons, NO clocks, NO detached objects, NO checkerboard. Full bleed architectural texture only. The seam between the two strips is exactly at the image center. Avoid huge roof expanses or bulky objects. Consistent realistic small architectural detail sizes, dark glass windows and patinated metal alongside worn painted wood.
